d:
Amra Chas Kori Anonde - A tribute to all the farmers across India, whose sweat and blood ensure that the Nation is well-fed. We as the citizen of India need to come ahead and pledge that we would do everything and anything in our power to uplift our rural brothers and sisters.
A farmer is an artist.
Listen to Arijit Singh giving voice to Rabindranath Tagore’s beautiful lyrics and composition, echoing a farmer’s message.
Director
Arijit Singh, Koyel Singh
Story & Script
Koyel Singh
